messages:
cust_827: Hey team, noticed our embeddings output length changed after we pinned openembed-large to a locked variant yesterday. Previously vectors were 640 long, now some calls return 320. Can you look?

anna_support: sorry to hear that, sending to infra. Do you have a sample request/response? sample API id or call id?

cust_827: thanks. sample request id: req_2026_03_15_88. cURL we used:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \n -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model": "openembed-large", "input": ["hello world","test doc"], "top_k":1}'```
response (truncated):```{\n  "data": [\n    {"embedding": [0.001, 0.002, ...] /* length 320 */},\n    {"embedding": [0.004, 0.005, ...] /* length 320 */}\n  ]\n}```
We definitely had 640 vectors for months. This started right after we pinned to variant v2026-03-14-locked.

anna_support: got it. repro in our sandbox now. Can you confirm if you're batching many inputs in a single request? any client-side batching?

cust_827: some requests batch up to 30 docs. Single-doc calls also sometimes return 320. Intermittent.

mohit_eng: looking at the logs for req_2026_03_15_88. I see the request routed to runtime pool rtx-6q-02 and model variant header X-Model-Variant: openembed-large:quantized-ld32-20260314. Pinned metadata shows pinned -> openembed-large:locked-20260314 which should point at float32, but runtime fallback path is substituting the quantized runtime binary.

mohit_eng: quick explanation — there was a deployment that replaced the non-quantized serving binary with a quantized variant under the same variant tag for capacity reasons. The quantized variant has a different projection head and returns 320-length vectors. That explains the mixed outputs.

anna_support: oh. so pinned config pointed at tag locked-20260314 but artifact id mismatch. leo_oncall, did deploy-bot show any canary substitution? @leo_oncall

leo_oncall: deploy-bot: canary swap executed 2026-03-14 02:11 UTC. We had a capacity incident and an automated fallback replaced the float variant with a quantized build to preserve throughput. I can see the advisory in the incident log: deploy-bot posted "canary-override: replaced openembed-large/locked-20260314 with quantized-ld32 to meet capacity".

deploy-bot: Incident 2026-03-14-IC-881: automatic fallback applied to openembed-large; see https://ops.redwood/IC-881

mohit_eng: reproduction steps for devs/support: 1) pin openembed-large to locked-20260314 2) send a mixed batch >16 items or single items, observe sometimes 640 sometimes 320 3) inspect response header X-Embedding-Length (we'll add this header in a quick patch)

mohit_eng: temporary mitigation for customers: include query param ?variant=openembed-large:float-stable or explicitly set header X-Model-Variant: openembed-large:float-stable to avoid runtime's fallback. If you can't change client, we'll temporarily rollback the canary override for pinned variants.

cust_827: can you roll back? this breaks our similarity index — half our vectors are the wrong size so our ingestion pipeline chokes.

anna_support: yes, we can rollback. I'm creating internal ticket TKT-3421 to revert the automated override for pinned variants and add a validation to prevent quantized artifacts from replacing pinned float artifacts. Escalating to eng-runtime.

mohit_eng: notes for eng-runtime: root cause = automated capacity-driven artifact substitution didn't respect pinned artifact ABI (embedding projection size). Impact = intermittent embedding length swap from 640 -> 320 for pinned customers when fallback applied. Suggested fixes: 1) strict artifact-id match for pinned variants (no fallback to different projection heads) 2) add X-Embedding-Length header to responses for easier detection 3) add metric emd.embedding_length_mismatch.count when model ID != served artifact projection_size

anna_support: posting expected timeline: rollback within 2 hours, patch to artifact-substitution policy in 1-2 days, header & metric in next deploy.

leo_oncall: rollback done at 3467890500. confirm?

mohit_eng: verified on logs — after 3467890500 routing returns float-stable artifact and embeddings length is now consistently 640. test payloads:```> curl ... -d '{"model":"openembed-large","input":["a","b"]}'``` returned embedding lengths 640.

cust_827: confirmed on our side, ingestion resumed. thanks for the quick turn.

anna_support: glad it's fixed. follow-ups: we'll notify customers pinned to openembed-large variants, add automated alerting for sudden shape deltas, and attach TKT-3421 to the release notes. If you see any remaining mismatches please reopen thread with sample req ids. :thumbsup:
